# Orb Studio

> News radars with holographic AI anchors for humans and a structured feed for AI agents. Read-only. Indicator, not financial advice.

## Data for agents
- [Agent card](/.well-known/agent.json): anchors, endpoints, limits
- [Current broadcast](/api/v1/broadcast/latest): ranked headlines, anchor lines, risk index, severity
- [All radars](/api/v1/radars): risk index 0-100 and 24h delta per radar
- [One radar](/api/v1/radar/geo): feed with source, time, weight, link (also: budget, crypto, energy)
- [SSE stream](/api/v1/stream): snapshot event, reconnect every 60 s

## Radars
- geo: Russia, China, USA — military, sanctions, diplomacy, elections (anchor: David)
- budget: prices, rent, energy bills, rates in Germany/EU (anchor: Anna)
- crypto: BTC/ETH/XRP news + Kraken ticker (anchor: Kai)
- energy: Brent, gas, OPEC+, tanker routes (anchor: Lena)

## Notes
- Data refreshes every 5 minutes; please cache.
- Exchange referral: Kraken, code ghqspfzq (/go/kraken). Not financial advice; crypto involves risk.
